name: Pfizer
notes: Pfizer reports no operating income line, so operatingIncome is derived for every year (quality estimated): revenues less cost of sales, selling/informational/administrative expenses, R&D, amortization of intangible assets, acquired and merger-related IPR&D, restructuring/merger/acquisition-related costs (2000-2004 'merger-related costs') and, in 2019, the 8,086 gain on the Consumer Healthcare JV transaction. 'Other (income)/deductions-net' (interest, asset impairments, litigation, investment gains) is excluded; the result equals income from continuing operations before taxes plus that line. Fiscal year ends Dec 31 (international subsidiaries Nov 30). Figures taken from the 10-K covering each year as presented there (some later restated for discontinued operations: e.g. 2019 includes Upjohn, 2020+ excludes it; 2023 reflects FY2025 10-K presentation). Amortization of intangibles is a separate line from 2003 (earlier years it sits in cost of sales and SI&A), so 2002->2003 has a small presentation break in the components, not in the total.
